bibliography.abstract: Text-driven 3D generation has advanced rapidly in creating large-scale outdoor environments and detailed indoor scenes, but these domains are usually synthesized independently, lacking the correspondence required for a coherent urban world. We present HoloWorld, a unified indoor-outdoor urban world generation framework built on a continuously updated cross-scale world context. Initializing from a user description, HoloWorld progressively represents and updates the diverse world information, from city-scale planning to individual buildings, allowing generated interiors to maintain explicit correspondence with their associated exterior buildings. Conditioned on the evolving context and previously generated neighboring blocks, HoloWorld autoregressively generates urban exteriors with consistent spatial organization and visual identity across blocks. The generated exterior representations are further grounded in 3D building instances and footprints, enabling building-specific indoor generation with geometry-constrained layouts and inherited appearance characteristics. To our knowledge, HoloWorld is the first framework to unify indoor and outdoor generation within a coherent 3D urban world. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HoloWorld achieves superior urban exterior generation performance, improving the average AQS score over the SOTA by 7.68\% and obtaining the highest average RDR score, while maintaining strong building-level indoor-outdoor correspondence and cross-block continuity within a unified 3D urban world.
bibliography.title: To See a World in a Living Context: Unified Indoor-Outdoor Urban World Generation

topics.label: Generative Adversarial Networks and Image Synthesis

en.what: The researchers developed HoloWorld, a text-driven 3D generation framework that synthesizes unified indoor and outdoor urban environments using a continuously updated cross-scale world context. The system autoregressively generates urban exteriors across blocks and grounds them in 3D building footprints to generate geometry-constrained, matching indoor layouts. In evaluations, the framework improved the average Aesthetic Quality Score (AQS) by 7.68% over current state-of-the-art models and achieved the highest average Realistic Detail Ratio (RDR).
en.why: It establishes a method to generate coherent 3D virtual cities where individual building interiors maintain explicit spatial, geometric, and visual correspondence with their external structures, a capability previously limited by the independent synthesis of indoor and outdoor environments.
